nameOrigin: of great size/importance; lord or master

pokedexEntries.ru: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

pokedexEntries.sa: GROUDON has the power to scatter rain clouds and make water evaporate with light and heat. It came as a savior to people who had been suffering from terrible floods.

pokedexEntries.frlg: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

pokedexEntries.em: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.

pokedexEntries.bw: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

pokedexEntries.x: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

pokedexEntries.y: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

pokedexEntries.or: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

pokedexEntries.as: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
